categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the design, R&D, production, and sales of precision structural parts and molds. Its main business segments include precision metal structural parts, precision plastic structural parts, and molds, serving industries such as photovoltaics, energy storage, new energy vehicles, security, and consumer electronics. The automotive sector, especially new energy vehicles, has become the largest business segment, followed by photovoltaics and energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include precision die casting, precision injection molding, profile processing, and metal stamping. The company employs advanced manufacturing methods such as high-vacuum die casting for aluminum alloy parts, CAD and CAE for mold design and simulation, and automation and intelligent production lines including robotic automation for casting, injection molding, stamping, CNC machining, and drilling. It also focuses on R&D in integrated structural parts and lightweight aluminum-magnesium alloy components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are leading enterprises in the new energy vehicle, photovoltaic, energy storage, security, and consumer electronics sectors, many of which are global industry leaders or Fortune 500 companies. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales to overseas high-margin core customers. Key markets include China, Europe, North America, and emerging markets in Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases across China including Guangdong, Jiangsu, Sichuan, Chongqing, and Jiangxi provinces, forming industrial clusters in the Pearl River Delta, Yangtze River Delta, western and central China. It has expanded overseas with production facilities in Mexico and Hungary to better serve international customers and shorten delivery cycles. The company’s sales cover Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing precision structural components and molds that are critical parts for downstream industries such as automotive, photovoltaics, and energy storage. It procures raw materials like aluminum ingots, plastic pellets, and aluminum extrusion materials from upstream suppliers and delivers finished components directly to end-product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening penetration in clean energy sectors (new energy vehicles, photovoltaics, energy storage), expanding into emerging industries like robotics and liquid cooling, and accelerating overseas market development. R&D focuses on lightweight integrated structural parts, high-vacuum die casting technologies, rapid assembly equipment for photovoltaic inverters, and optimization of aluminum alloy compositions to improve product quality and reduce costs. The company also emphasizes automation, intelligent manufacturing, and continuous innovation to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision structural parts and molds to customers, based on customized orders. The company follows a direct sales model, providing one-stop procurement services with products tailored to customer specifications. It also earns income from mold sales and government subsidies, with a small portion from other business activities such as raw material and scrap sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading precision structural parts supplier with strong technical capabilities and a diversified product portfolio. It competes with other precision manufacturing firms serving the automotive, photovoltaic, and energy storage sectors. Its competitive advantages include multi-material and multi-process manufacturing, global customer base, and overseas production facilities. The company holds industry recognitions such as ranking among China’s top 50 die casting producers and being listed among Guangdong’s top 500 manufacturing enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.56 billion, a 37.12% decline from the previous year, mainly due to inventory destocking in the photovoltaic sector and reduced sales to overseas high-margin customers. Net profit attributable to shareholders was a loss of RMB 469 million, compared to a profit in 2023. The company’s total assets reached RMB 6.1 billion, with an 8.23% increase year-over-year. Despite short-term financial pressure, the company is investing heavily in overseas production bases and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive one-stop solution for precision structural parts, combining multiple materials (metal and plastic) and manufacturing processes (die casting, injection molding, stamping) to meet diverse customer needs. It emphasizes high product quality, precision, stability, and customization capabilities, supported by advanced R&D and manufacturing equipment. Its global production footprint and close collaboration with leading customers enable faster delivery and enhanced service, differentiating it from competitors and fostering strong customer loyalty.
